detail: the GitHub machine identity is not installed in this host's data root, so the promotion path has no credential to act with
requiredExternalAction: Install the Codex-Boss GitHub App machine identity on this host (`corepack pnpm run bootstrap:github-machine`, Owner-run, private key kept in platform secure storage), then re-run `corepack pnpm run acceptance:promotion-identity:live`.
credentialRequiredAction: Create a dedicated Boss GitHub identity (GitHub App or bot account) with contents:write, pull_requests:write and checks:read only, no repository administration and no ruleset bypass, then expose its token to Boss as CODEX_BOSS_GITHUB_TOKEN (and its login as CODEX_BOSS_GITHUB_IDENTITY).
